caption: The drawing consists of two vertical panels on a tan background. The left panel features a repeating pattern of green olive branches intertwined with flowing red and white striped ribbons, which have blue sections adorned with white stars. Along the far left edge, there is a narrow border decorated with a vertical vine of small blue flowers and leaves. The right panel displays repeating motifs of American flags, cannons, and shields, all predominantly colored in red, white, blue, and some metallic gray. An eagle, colored white with touches of gray, is depicted at the lower center of the right panel, clutching green olive branches and arrows. Above the eagle, there is a group of crossed American flags and cannons with a centrally placed shield bearing stars and stripes. Large silver stars are positioned near the top and bottom of the panel. The composition uses a palette consisting mainly of tan, green, red, white, blue, gray, and a small amount of off-white. A scale is drawn at the bottom left of the page.
title: Wall Paper and Border
